request.subject: UNIT:MONSTER_GIANT_SPIDER

layers.text: Style: bold chibi pixel art for a playful turn-based strategy board game, a board game come to life: chunky simple shapes, flat colours with one shadow tone, low detail, clean readable silhouette that reads at a glance at small size, slightly silly and cheerful.
layers.negative: photorealism, painterly brushwork, gradients, dithering, noise, tiny details, thin outline, low-poly 3D, faceted polygons, blur, text, letters, numbers, logo, UI, frame, health bar, selection ring, cropped subject

layers.text: Camera: consistent strategy-game camera, three-quarter view looking slightly down, the subject faces down and to the right (south-east), whole subject visible and centred on a transparent background, nothing cropped. The subject stands directly on the empty transparent background: nothing at all is drawn under it.

Class: one chunky cute wild monster map piece that belongs to nobody, a single creature with a big simple body, big round eyes and a clear silhouette that reads at a glance, thick single-colour black outline; the whole creature is visible and its feet are the lowest thing in the image. It wears nothing and carries nothing. Its colours are earthy neutrals only: dusty umber brown, taupe, charcoal and bone white.

layers.text: Subject: a giant spider, chunky and cute and a little menacing: a big round fuzzy abdomen at the back with two bone-white stripes across it, a smaller round head at the front with four big round glossy black eyes with white shine dots and two short bone-white fangs, and eight thick short bent hairy legs, four on each side, spread wide so that every leg is clearly visible; dusty umber-brown fur with a darker brown shadow tone and bone-white leg tips; the spider is wider than it is tall and nearly as wide as the image; the leg tips are the lowest thing in the image.
